product_description: A fictional all-in-one workspace for notes, docs, databases, calendar, and mail, modeled on tools like Notion.
dataset: Customer complaints, December 2025 to October 2026. Companion to tessera_changelog. C101 to C115 are near misses added 2026-11-09, each dated before a release in the same area that does not fix it.

complaints.title: No Elixir syntax highlighting in code blocks
complaints.text: Our team writes a lot of Elixir and we keep all our runbooks in Tessera. Code blocks only offer Plain Text for it, so every snippet is a gray wall. Could you add Elixir highlighting? Haskell would be great too.

complaints.title: Duplicating a page drops the cover image
complaints.text: Every time I duplicate one of my project pages, the copy comes out with no cover image and no icon. I have to go back and set them up by hand each time.

complaints.title: Setting up relations is confusing
complaints.text: I tried to link my Projects and Tasks databases and ended up with three half-configured relation properties. Picking the property type, finding the right database, and adding a rollup are all separate steps and I never know if I did it right.

complaints.title: Terraform snippets render as plain text
complaints.text: We document our infrastructure in Tessera and none of our Terraform (HCL) code gets highlighted. When we export the page to PDF for audits it is even harder to read.

complaints.title: Pages created from templates lose their icon and banner
complaints.text: I built a nice template with a banner and an icon, but every page I create from it is plain. The content copies over fine, just not the look.

complaints.title: Windows app crashes when pasting a spreadsheet
complaints.text: I copied about 800 rows from Excel and pasted them into a page. The Windows app froze and then closed. I lost a few minutes of edits. It happens every time with big tables.

complaints.title: 40,000-row CRM table takes forever to load
complaints.text: Our sales CRM table has about 40,000 rows. Opening it takes 10 to 15 seconds and every filter change locks the page for several more. The sales team has started keeping a spreadsheet on the side.

complaints.title: Sidebar sections keep expanding after reload
complaints.text: Since the new sidebar came out, I collapse the teamspaces I never use and they all pop open again the next time I load Tessera. With 14 teamspaces this makes the sidebar useless.

complaints.title: Cards jump back when I drag them on iPhone
complaints.text: Moving a card from To Do to Doing on my iPhone works maybe half the time. The other half it snaps right back to the column it came from, especially after I scroll the column.

complaints.title: Tessera Mail shows every reply as a separate email
complaints.text: A single back and forth with a vendor turns into 12 separate items in my inbox. Every other mail app groups these into one conversation.

complaints.title: Can't tell how a relation will look on the other database
complaints.text: When I add a relation I have no idea what the property will be called in the other database until I go look. A preview before I confirm would save me a lot of cleanup.

complaints.title: All-day events show up a day early for US teammates
complaints.text: I am in London and I put our company offsite on the calendar as an all-day event on February 12. My colleagues in San Francisco see it on February 11.

complaints.title: Filtering a big board view freezes the app
complaints.text: We have a support board with around 18,000 cards. Applying a filter makes the whole window stop responding for a few seconds.

complaints.title: Bring back the old flat page list
complaints.text: The teamspace grouping in 3.0 might work for big companies, but I'm a team of three. I liked seeing all my pages in one list. Please give us the option to go back.

complaints.title: SSO sessions stay active for weeks
complaints.text: Our identity provider policy requires people to re-authenticate at least every 12 hours. Tessera sessions in our SSO workspace stay signed in for weeks, which our security team flagged in this quarter's review.

complaints.title: Old duplicated pages are still missing their covers
complaints.text: New duplicates keep their covers now, but the 30 or so pages I duplicated last fall are still blank. Is there a way to fix them all at once?

complaints.title: No way to list every guest in our workspace
complaints.text: For our annual access review I need a list of every external guest and what they can reach. Right now I have to open the share menu on hundreds of pages one at a time.

complaints.title: Emails show up 10+ minutes late on Android
complaints.text: I missed a time-sensitive email because it took about 12 minutes to appear in Tessera Mail on my Pixel. When I open the app it suddenly shows up. Gmail had it right away.

complaints.title: Search can't find text inside database rows
complaints.text: I know there is a row in our Vendors database that mentions 'net 60', but searching for it returns nothing. Search only seems to find page titles.

complaints.title: Can't archive a whole conversation at once
complaints.text: When a long email exchange is done I have to archive each message one by one. I want to archive or snooze the whole conversation in one go.

complaints.title: Gallery view of our asset library is still painfully slow
complaints.text: Our design asset library has about 25,000 rows and we use gallery view. It still takes a long time to load and scrolling stutters, even after the recent speed update.

complaints.title: AI answers don't say where they came from
complaints.text: Tessera AI gave me a confident answer about our refund policy but there is no way to see which page it used. I can't send that to a customer without checking, and I can't check.

complaints.title: Mac app crashes when I paste a big table from Numbers
complaints.text: Pasting a 700-row table from Numbers closes the Mac app. I saw a fix for this on Windows but it still happens on my Mac.

complaints.title: Tessera AI replies in English when I ask in Korean
complaints.text: Half of our team works in Korean. When we ask Tessera AI a question in Korean it answers in English, and the Improve writing action mangles Korean text.

complaints.title: Can't relate databases across two workspaces
complaints.text: We have a separate workspace for our agency clients. The new relation builder only lists databases in the current workspace.

complaints.title: Please let Cmd+P open quick search
complaints.text: In every editor I use, Cmd+P jumps to a file. In Tessera it opens the print dialog, which I never want. Could Cmd+P open search instead?

complaints.title: No way to verify an AI summary
complaints.text: I asked for a summary of last month's meeting notes. It looks right, but I would like links back to the actual pages so I can confirm the details before I share it.

complaints.title: Editing one recurring event changes all of them
complaints.text: I moved this week's team standup to 10am and every future standup moved too. There is no 'only this event' option.

complaints.title: Want weekly meeting notes created automatically
complaints.text: Every Monday someone has to remember to create the weekly sync page from our template. Can Tessera just create it on a schedule?

complaints.title: Page history only goes back 30 days
complaints.text: A teammate deleted a section of our handbook two months ago and I can't restore it because history only goes back 30 days on our plan.

complaints.title: Slack notifications are flooding my DMs
complaints.text: I get a separate Slack message for every comment and edit on pages I follow, sometimes 60 a day. I would rather get one summary.

complaints.title: Admins can't see how much AI the team is using
complaints.text: We are close to our AI allowance some months and I have no idea which teams are using it or for what. I need some visibility before renewal.

complaints.title: No Microsoft Teams integration
complaints.text: Our company runs on Microsoft Teams, not Slack. We can't get any Tessera notifications where people actually work.

complaints.title: Search ignores comments and attached PDFs
complaints.text: Most of our decisions happen in comment threads, and our contracts are attached as PDFs. Search finds neither, so I end up scrolling through pages by hand.

complaints.title: Can't open anything on a plane
complaints.text: I prepared my talk notes in Tessera and then couldn't open them on the flight because there was no connection. The app just shows a spinner.

complaints.title: Threads from Outlook users don't group
complaints.text: Several of our clients still use an old version of Outlook, and their replies show up as separate items instead of in the thread.

complaints.title: Wish there was a home screen widget
complaints.text: I open the same three pages all day. A widget with my recent pages would save me a lot of taps.

complaints.title: Tessera AI doesn't speak Thai
complaints.text: You added six languages last month but Thai still isn't supported. Our Bangkok office gets answers in English.

complaints.title: Search results are a jumble with no filters
complaints.text: Searching our wiki returns hundreds of results with no way to narrow by teamspace or by who wrote the page. I gave up and asked a coworker instead.

complaints.title: Guest audit doesn't show public web links
complaints.text: The guest list is a big help, but it doesn't show pages that are published to the web with a public link, which is the bigger risk for us.

complaints.title: New emails take forever to appear on iPhone
complaints.text: Mail on my iPhone is often 10 minutes behind when the app is in the background. I saw the Android fix, but nothing changed on iOS.

complaints.title: Moving a private draft made it visible to the whole company
complaints.text: A manager dragged a private performance review draft into the All Hands teamspace by accident. It inherited the teamspace permissions and about 200 people could see it. There was no warning at all.

complaints.title: Built-in page icons disappear in dark mode
complaints.text: With dark mode on, a lot of the standard outline icons on my pages are dark gray on a black background. I can barely see them.

complaints.title: Why is AI locked behind a paid plan?
complaints.text: Every time I click the AI button it tells me to upgrade. Even a few free questions a month would let me see if it's worth paying for.

complaints.title: Ctrl+P doesn't print anymore
complaints.text: I print meeting agendas several times a day and Ctrl+P now opens search instead. Please put it back or let me choose.

complaints.title: Search filters reset every time I open a result
complaints.text: I set the teamspace and date filters, tap a result, go back, and the filters are gone. I have to set them again for every result I check.

complaints.title: Repeating templates can't skip holidays
complaints.text: Our weekly sync template keeps creating pages on public holidays when nobody is working. I'd like to skip specific dates.

complaints.title: Need offline access on my commute
complaints.text: My train goes through a long stretch with no signal. I would like to read and edit my to-do pages without a connection and have them sync later.

complaints.title: Pages-only filter still shows database rows
complaints.text: I filter search to Pages only and database rows still show up in the results on my Android phone.

complaints.title: Windows app uses 3GB of RAM
complaints.text: After a few hours with Tessera open, Task Manager shows it using around 3GB of memory and my laptop slows to a crawl.

complaints.title: Need a way to let clients book time with me
complaints.text: I spend way too long emailing clients back and forth to find a meeting time. I want to send a link where they can pick a free slot from my Tessera calendar.

complaints.title: Search doesn't look inside attached Excel files
complaints.text: The new search finds text inside our PDFs, which is great, but most of our price lists are attached Excel files and none of that shows up.

complaints.title: Pricing page doesn't explain what happens if I downgrade
complaints.text: Before I upgrade I want to know what happens to my pages if I go back to Free later, and whether guests count as seats. The plan comparison page doesn't say.

complaints.title: Upgrade flow is four screens and I lost track of the total
complaints.text: I went through plan, seats, billing details, and payment on four different screens. By the end I wasn't sure what I was actually going to be charged, so I closed the tab.

complaints.title: The / menu is a giant list and new teammates get lost
complaints.text: When new people join our workspace they type / and scroll through 60 options with no idea what most of them do. Some grouping or descriptions would help a lot.

complaints.title: AI cited a page that doesn't say what it claimed
complaints.text: Tessera AI told me our contract renewal date was March 1 and cited our Contracts page. I opened the citation and the page says April 1. The citation made me trust it more, which is worse.

complaints.title: Task deadlines don't show on Tessera Calendar
complaints.text: Our tasks database has due dates, but none of them show up on Tessera Calendar. I have to check two places to see what my week looks like.

complaints.title: No support for hardware security keys
complaints.text: Our security policy requires hardware keys for two-factor sign in. Tessera only supports authenticator apps, so we can't roll it out to the finance team.

complaints.title: Can't pay with Apple Pay when upgrading
complaints.text: Tried to upgrade on my phone and the only option is typing in a card number. Please support Apple Pay.

complaints.title: Offline mode only downloads part of our inventory database
complaints.text: I made our 12,000-row inventory database available offline for warehouse checks. Offline, about half the items are just missing.

complaints.title: Teamspace grouping wastes space in the sidebar
complaints.text: Half my sidebar is teamspace headers. I just want a simple list of pages like before.

complaints.title: Invoice shows $ but we're billed in euros
complaints.text: Our June invoice PDF lists every amount with a dollar sign, but we pay in euros. Finance can't file it like this.

complaints.title: My custom uploaded icons vanish in dark mode
complaints.text: The built-in icons look fine in dark mode now, but the black logo icons I uploaded for each client page are invisible on the dark background.

complaints.title: Want a weekly Slack digest option
complaints.text: Daily digests are still too much for pages I only skim. A weekly digest would be perfect.

complaints.title: Relation builder crashes in our workspace
complaints.text: Clicking Add property and then Relation crashes the page every time. A colleague in another workspace says it works for them. We do have a lot of archived databases, if that matters.

complaints.title: Updating the same task in GitHub and Tessera is a pain
complaints.text: We plan in Tessera and track issues in GitHub. Every status change has to be made twice, and they are always out of sync.

complaints.title: Accounting rejected our invoice because of the currency symbol
complaints.text: We are billed in pounds but the invoice PDF shows dollars. Our accountant sent it back. Can you reissue it?

complaints.title: Booking links aren't available on Free
complaints.text: I saw the booking links announcement, but when I click Share availability it says I need Plus. I only need one link.

complaints.title: App takes ages to open
complaints.text: Every time I tap the Tessera icon I stare at a loading screen for several seconds before my page appears. I usually just open the website instead.

complaints.title: No PayPal option at checkout
complaints.text: The new checkout is much clearer, but I pay for all my software through PayPal and there is no option for it. Card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay only.

complaints.title: Tablet app is just a stretched phone app
complaints.text: On my Android tablet the app looks like a blown-up phone screen. The sidebar disappears when I open a page and split screen doesn't work.

complaints.title: Stop showing me upgrade buttons, I can't buy anything
complaints.text: I am a regular member of our company workspace. Every time I click a feature we don't have, Tessera asks me to upgrade. I have no budget and no access to billing.

complaints.title: Enterprise can't add seats ourselves
complaints.text: Everyone else gets the new one-page checkout but on Enterprise we still have to go through our account manager to add even two seats. It takes a week.

complaints.title: Daily Slack digest arrives at 2am
complaints.text: I set my Slack digest to daily, which should be 9am. It shows up at 2am Pacific instead. I never set a timezone in Slack, if that helps.

complaints.title: Apple Pay fails with a generic error
complaints.text: I'm trying to upgrade using Apple Pay with my German bank card and it fails every time with 'Payment could not be completed'. My card works everywhere else.

complaints.title: Booking links can't round-robin across our sales team
complaints.text: Booking links work for one person, but we need a single link that assigns the meeting to whichever of our six reps is free.

complaints.title: Newsletters bury important email
complaints.text: My Tessera inbox is mostly newsletters and receipts. I'd love for the app to sort them out automatically so I only see what needs a reply.

complaints.title: Markdown export flattens toggles
complaints.text: When I export a page to Markdown, everything inside toggle blocks becomes flat text and nested toggles lose their structure.

complaints.title: Still slow to open pages I haven't visited recently
complaints.text: The app itself opens faster now, but any page I haven't opened in a while still takes several seconds to load.

complaints.title: Had to email support just to remove seats
complaints.text: Upgrading took 30 seconds in the new checkout. Removing four seats after a reorg took two days of emailing support.

complaints.title: Invoices don't include our VAT number
complaints.text: The currency on our invoices is fixed, thanks. But there is still nowhere to add our VAT number, which we need for tax filing in Ireland.

complaints.title: Database tables are unusable with NVDA
complaints.text: I use NVDA. In table view the cells have no labels, so I hear 'blank' over and over, and I can't move between cells with the keyboard. I rely on a coworker to update my rows.

complaints.title: No stylus handwriting on my Galaxy Tab
complaints.text: The new tablet layout is great. I'd love to write notes with my S Pen, but handwriting isn't supported at all.

complaints.title: Pull requests don't sync as rows
complaints.text: The GitHub sync is great for issues, but we also want our pull requests in the database so we can track review status in one place.

complaints.title: Auto-labels missing in the Android app
complaints.text: I turned on auto-labels on the web and they work there, but on my Android phone none of the labels or settings show up.

complaints.title: Text and borders too faint, need high contrast
complaints.text: I have low vision and the light gray text and borders are hard for me to read. Is there a high contrast theme?

complaints.title: We have to poll the API every minute to catch changes
complaints.text: Our integration needs to know when rows change in a database. Right now we poll every minute, which is slow and burns through our rate limit. Any plans for webhooks?

complaints.title: Upgrading is one click, downgrading is impossible to find
complaints.text: Funny how easy it is to upgrade and how hard it is to downgrade. I've looked through every billing setting and can't find it.

complaints.title: Upgrade banners everywhere in our Plus workspace
complaints.text: I'm not the admin of our Plus workspace but I see upgrade buttons all over the place. I heard you turned these off for Business members. Why not for us?

complaints.title: One repository per synced database doesn't work for us
complaints.text: Our product is split across five repositories. I want one Tessera database showing issues from all of them, but each synced database only connects to one repo.

complaints.title: Timeline view still isn't accessible with a screen reader
complaints.text: Table view works with JAWS now, thank you. But our roadmap lives in timeline view and it is still completely unlabeled.

complaints.title: Tessera AI takes 8+ seconds to start answering
complaints.text: We have around 120,000 pages. Every Q&A question sits on 'Searching your workspace' for eight seconds or more before any text appears.

complaints.title: High contrast mode changes my highlight colors
complaints.text: I color-code my study notes with highlights. In high contrast mode the yellow and orange look almost the same, so the system falls apart.

complaints.title: Tagging feedback rows by hand takes hours
complaints.text: We collect customer feedback in a database and someone spends every Friday tagging each row by theme. Could Tessera AI fill in a property like that?

complaints.title: Our internal sync script broke overnight with 410 errors
complaints.text: Our nightly script that copies pages into our data warehouse started failing with 410 Gone. Nothing changed on our side.

complaints.title: Webhooks only cover databases, not regular pages
complaints.text: We want to trigger a review workflow when someone edits a policy page, but webhooks only fire for database rows.

complaints.title: Same webhook event arrives two or three times
complaints.text: When several people edit a row at once, our endpoint receives the same update two or three times, and our downstream system creates duplicate records.

complaints.title: 20 webhook subscriptions isn't enough
complaints.text: We have 35 databases that our integration needs to watch, but each integration is capped at 20 webhook subscriptions.

complaints.title: AI autofill doesn't work on date or number properties
complaints.text: I wanted autofill to pull the due date and the dollar amount out of each request row, but the option only shows up on text and select properties.

complaints.title: Autofill burned through our AI allowance in two days
complaints.text: Someone turned on autofill for existing rows on a 9,000-row database and we hit 90% of our monthly AI allowance by Tuesday. There was no warning about the cost before it ran.

complaints.title: Mac app crashes when pasting a big table
complaints.text: I copied about 600 rows from Numbers and pasted them into a page. The Mac app froze for a few seconds and then quit. Smaller tables paste fine.

complaints.title: Gallery view takes forever on our photo library
complaints.text: Our product photo database has about 30,000 rows, and the team only browses it in gallery view. Opening it takes more than 10 seconds, and applying a filter freezes the page.

complaints.title: New mail shows up late on my iPhone
complaints.text: When Tessera Mail is in the background on my iPhone, new emails can take 10 to 15 minutes to appear. They show up right away as soon as I open the app.

complaints.title: Tessera AI answers in English when we ask in Hebrew
complaints.text: Our Tel Aviv team asks Tessera AI questions in Hebrew and always gets the answer in English. Translate and Fix spelling and grammar don't handle Hebrew either.

complaints.title: Search doesn't find text in attached slide decks
complaints.text: We attach our quarterly review decks as PowerPoint files. Searching for a phrase I know is on one of the slides returns nothing.

complaints.title: Desktop app is useless without wifi
complaints.text: I work on trains a lot. The Mac app shows a blank page as soon as I lose my connection, even for pages I opened an hour ago. I'd like to keep reading and editing and have it sync later.

complaints.title: Let me share a scheduling link
complaints.text: I'm a freelancer on the Free plan and spend too much time emailing clients to find a meeting time. A link where they could pick an open slot on my Tessera calendar would save me hours.

complaints.title: Can't pay by invoice or bank transfer
complaints.text: Our finance team can only pay software vendors by bank transfer against an invoice. Tessera checkout only takes cards, so we can't move up to Business.

complaints.title: Invoices only come in English
complaints.text: Our accountant in Munich needs invoices in German for our records. Tessera invoice PDFs are only in English, and there's no language setting for them.

complaints.title: Scrolling big databases on iPhone is choppy
complaints.text: Scrolling through our 3,000-row inventory table on my iPhone stutters badly and sometimes jumps back to the top.

complaints.title: iPhone sidebar is just a stack of teamspace headers
complaints.text: On my iPhone the sidebar is a long stack of teamspace headers, and I have to expand each one to find a page. A simple flat list of pages would be much faster.

complaints.title: Upgrade popups for people who can't buy anything
complaints.text: I'm a regular member of our Plus workspace with no billing access, but I keep getting asked to upgrade whenever I click a feature we don't have.

complaints.title: Gallery view can't be used with a keyboard
complaints.text: I navigate Tessera entirely by keyboard. In gallery view I can't move between cards or open one without a mouse, and my screen reader announces nothing.

complaints.title: Need webhooks when someone comments
complaints.text: Our support integration should react when someone comments on a database row. We'd like a webhook for new comments instead of polling the comments endpoint every few minutes.

complaints.title: Let AI assign an owner to new requests
complaints.text: We triage incoming requests in a database. It would save a lot of time if Tessera AI could read each request and fill in the Owner property based on the topic.
